name: Murata Miki
source:
[Club member with an extraordinary body and large areola]

She's the tallest member of the club. She has a calm and gentle personality, and because of her mature appearance, the club members her age treat her like a mother, which is confusing to her.

Even when the club members are making a fuss, she stands a step back with a smile, but she is strong-willed and does not back down even in the face of robbers, and she also has a bold side, such as stating her opinions.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara04.html]official site[/url]]
